buyer_question: Which workflows touch patient-identifiable or health data?
safe_first_review_input: Redacted workflow names plus data-category labels and owner notes

unsafe_claim_boundary: Do not claim PDPL/DHA/DoH/MOHAP compliance or safe patient-data handling from this template.

buyer_question: What messages can be automated and what must stop for human review?
safe_first_review_input: Script categories consent checkpoints unresolved queue counts and synthetic examples
excluded_before_scope: Real WhatsApp exports, call recordings, urgent symptom details, diagnosis or medication messages
unsafe_claim_boundary: Do not claim AI accuracy, clinical safety, appointment growth or patient outcome improvement.

buyer_question: What evidence exists for health-information-exchange or integration handoffs?
safe_first_review_input: Integration purpose data-category owner and open questions without identifiers
excluded_before_scope: Credentials, API keys, regulator correspondence, production exports or exchange records
unsafe_claim_boundary: Do not claim Malaffi/NABIDH readiness or approval without accountable review.

buyer_question: Where are workloads and backups hosted and who owns restore proof?
safe_first_review_input: Cloud/service category region note backup cadence and last restore-test month without account access
excluded_before_scope: Cloud-console roles, keys, logs, database exports, patient files or private architecture diagrams
unsafe_claim_boundary: Do not claim resilience, availability, data residency or security compliance from summary notes.

buyer_question: Who can access systems and when was access last reviewed?
safe_first_review_input: Role names counts last-review date exception type and owner-approved screenshots with identities redacted
excluded_before_scope: Usernames, passwords, OTPs, tokens, admin invites or privileged mailbox/system access
unsafe_claim_boundary: Do not claim access control effectiveness or audit pass without formal evidence.

buyer_question: Which patient workflows drive cloud messaging LLM API or observability spend?
safe_first_review_input: Monthly cost category bands budget owner approval threshold and anomaly examples with identifiers removed

buyer_question: Which buyer questions are blocked because evidence or owner approval is missing?
